description: This script manages the startup, shutdown, and restart of the libvirtd virtualization daemon on startup/shutdown sequences. It includes functions for logging and checks for existing processes using PID files.

methods.name: log_begin_msg
methods.description: Logs the beginning of an operation with a message.

methods.name: log_end_msg
methods.description: Logs the end of an operation, indicating success or failure based on the exit status.

methods.name: log_warning_msg
methods.description: Outputs a warning message, possibly with fancy terminal output.
